EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A line of organized storms surged into eastern Iowa late in the day and produced severe winds and heavy rainfall. The strongest storms occurred in a swath just south of Interstate 80, including near Iowa City, producing thunderstorm wind gusts of 60 to 80 MPH. There were rainfall amounts of 2 to 3.50 inches.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Law Enforcement reported water flowing over a gravel road between What Cheer and Gibson. The time of the event was estimated using radar.
